points.title: 西域出生
points.description: 李白出生于碎叶城，今吉尔吉斯斯坦境内。他的家族据说是汉人后裔，但长期在西域生活。5岁时随父迁居四川江油。这段西域经历对李白后来的诗歌风格产生了深远影响，使其作品融入了异域风情和开阔视野。他的《关山月》等诗作中可见西域风情的痕迹。
points.descriptionEn: Li Bai was born in Suyye, now part of Kyrgyzstan. His family, of Han Chinese descent, had long resided in the Western Regions. At age five, he moved with his father to Jiangyou in Sichuan province. This Western upbringing profoundly influenced his poetic style, incorporating exotic elements and broad perspectives. Works like 'Moon over the Mountain Pass' reveal traces of Western influences in his poetry.

points.title: 蜀中成长
points.description: 李白在四川度过了他的童年和青少年时期，这段时光对他的文学启蒙至关重要。他在此地广泛阅读诸子百家典籍，并开始创作诗歌。15岁时已显露诗才，得到当地名士的赏识。蜀地的壮丽山水和道教文化深深影响了他的世界观和诗歌风格，形成了豪放飘逸的独特风格。这段时期创作的《峨眉山月歌》等作品已初显其诗歌才华。
points.descriptionEn: Li Bai spent his childhood and adolescence in Sichuan, a period crucial for his literary development. He extensively studied the classics of various schools of thought and began composing poetry. By age 15, his poetic talent was recognized and appreciated by local scholars. The magnificent landscapes and Taoist culture of Sichuan profoundly shaped his worldview and poetic style, forming his unique free-spirited and unrestrained approach. Works like 'Song of the Moon over Mount Emei' from this period already showcased his poetic genius.

points.title: 壮游天下
points.description: 25岁后，李白开始漫游天下，足迹遍布大半个中国。他先后游历了湖北、湖南、江苏、浙江、安徽等地，结交了许多文人墨客和地方官员。这段漫游经历极大地丰富了他的生活阅历和诗歌素材。在此期间，他创作了大量描绘山水风光和抒发豪情壮志的诗篇，如《望庐山瀑布》、《早发白帝城》等。虽然多次参加科举考试但未能及第，这促使他转向通过献诗和结交权贵来谋求仕途。
points.descriptionEn: After age 25, Li Bai began wandering across China, traveling through most of the empire. He visited Hubei, Hunan, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui and other regions, befounding numerous scholars and officials. This extensive wandering greatly enriched his life experiences and provided material for his poetry. During this period, he created numerous poems depicting landscapes and expressing heroic aspirations, such as 'Viewing the Lushan Waterfall' and 'Early Departure from White Emperor City'. Although he repeatedly attempted the imperial examinations without success, this led him to seek official positions through presenting poems and befounding powerful figures.

points.title: 供奉翰林
points.description: 742年，经道士吴筠推荐，李白被唐玄宗召入长安，供奉翰林。这是他政治生涯的巅峰时期。在长安期间，他深受唐玄宗赏识，为其创作了许多应制诗。然而，由于其狂放不羁的性格和对权贵的蔑视，很快遭到朝中官员的排挤。仅两年后便被迫离开长安。这段经历虽然短暂，但使李白对朝廷政治有了更深刻的认识，也创作了《清平调》等著名作品。离开长安后，他对仕途心灰意冷，更加专注于诗歌创作。
points.descriptionEn: In 742, recommended by the Daoist master Wu Yun, Li Bai was summoned to Chang'an by Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and appointed as an Imperial Academician. This marked the pinnacle of his political career. During his time in Chang'an, he was highly favored by the emperor and composed many court poems. However, due to his unrestrained personality and disdain for powerful officials, he quickly faced opposition from court members. After just two years, he was forced to leave Chang'an. Although brief, this experience gave Li Bai deeper insights into court politics and led to the creation of famous works like 'Peaceful Tune'. After leaving Chang'an, he became disillusioned with official life and focused even more on poetry.

points.title: 安陆隐居
points.description: 安史之乱爆发后，李白隐居在湖北安陆。这一时期，他目睹了战乱给国家和人民带来的苦难，创作了许多反映社会现实的诗作，如《战城南》、《行路难》等。756年，永王李璘起兵，邀请李白加入其幕府。李白欣然接受，希望能在乱世中施展抱负。然而，永王兵败后，李白被流放夜郎。这段政治挫折使他对仕途彻底失望，但也促使他的诗歌创作更加深刻和多元，融合了忧国忧民的情怀和个人命运的感慨。
points.descriptionEn: After the outbreak of the An Lushan Rebellion in 755, Li Bai took refuge in Anlu, Hubei Province. During this period, he witnessed the suffering inflicted upon the country and its people by the war, composing many poems reflecting social reality, such as 'Battle South of the City' and 'Hard is the Road to Travel'. In 756, Prince Li Lin launched a rebellion and invited Li Bai to join his staff. Li Bai gladly accepted, hoping to fulfill his ambitions during the chaotic times. However, after Prince Lin's defeat, Li Bai was exiled to Yelang. This political setback completely disillusioned him with official life but also led to more profound and diverse poetry, blending concerns for the nation with reflections on personal destiny.

points.title: 晚年漂泊
points.description: 759年，李白遇赦东归，晚年漂泊于安徽当涂等地。这一时期，他的生活更加贫困，但诗歌创作却达到了新的高度。他与当涂县令李阳冰交往密切，并在其家中度过了生命的最后时光。762年，李白在当涂病逝，享年62岁。晚年的李白虽然仕途失意，但诗歌成就更加辉煌，创作了《将进酒》、《梦游天姥吟留别》等千古名篇。他的诗歌不仅艺术成就极高，而且深刻反映了中国文人的精神追求和人生哲学，对后世产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 759, Li Bai was pardoned and returned east, wandering in his later years in places like Dangtu, Anhui. During this period, his life became more impoverished, but his poetry reached new heights. He maintained close relations with Li Yangbing, the magistrate of Dangtu, and spent his final days in Li's home. In 762, Li Bai died of illness in Dangtu at the age of 62. Although unsuccessful in his political career, Li Bai's poetic achievements became even more brilliant in his later years, creating timeless masterpieces like 'Bring in the Wine' and 'Dreaming of a Journey to Tianmu Mountain'. His poetry not only achieved extraordinary artistic merit but also profoundly reflected the spiritual pursuits and philosophical perspectives of Chinese literati, exerting far-reaching influence on later generations.

supporter.zh: 李白被誉为'诗仙'，是中国文学史上最伟大的浪漫主义诗人之一。他的诗歌豪放飘逸，想象丰富，语言清新自然，开创了中国古典诗歌的新境界。李白不仅以诗歌艺术成就著称，更以其自由不羁的精神和对理想的执着追求成为后世文人敬仰的典范。他的作品超越了时代局限，体现了人类对自由、理想和美的永恒追求，成为中国文化的瑰宝。
supporter.en: Li Bai is revered as the 'Immortal Poet' and one of China's greatest romantic poets in literary history. His poetry is characterized by its unrestrained spirit, rich imagination, and fresh, natural language, creating a new realm in classical Chinese poetry. Not only renowned for his artistic achievements, Li Bai also became a model admired by later literati for his free-spirited nature and persistent pursuit of ideals. His works transcend temporal limitations, embodying humanity's eternal quest for freedom, ideals, and beauty, becoming a treasure of Chinese culture.

critic.zh: 批评者认为李白过于追求个人自由而缺乏社会责任感，其诗歌多抒发个人情感而较少关注社会现实。他的政治生涯短暂且失败，显示出在复杂政治环境中的不适应。此外，李白的一些诗作被认为过于夸张和脱离现实，如'飞流直下三千尺'等描写虽有艺术价值但缺乏科学依据。他的生活方式也被批评为放荡不羁，不符合儒家传统文人的道德标准。
critic.en: Critics argue that Li Bai pursued personal freedom excessively while lacking social responsibility, with his poetry focusing more on personal emotions than social reality. His brief and unsuccessful political career shows his inability to adapt to complex political environments. Additionally, some of his poems are considered overly exaggerated and detached from reality, such as descriptions like 'the waterfall plunges three thousand feet' which possess artistic value but lack scientific basis. His lifestyle was also criticized as dissolute and not conforming to the moral standards of traditional Confucian literati.

objective.zh: 从历史学和流行文化视角看，李白已成为中国文化的重要符号，代表着浪漫主义精神和自由不羁的人生态度。他的诗歌被广泛传诵，影响了无数后世文人。在当代，李白形象被不断重塑，出现在各种文学、影视和艺术作品中，成为中国文化走向世界的重要名片。学术界对李白的研究已从单纯的文学赏析扩展到对其思想、历史背景和跨文化影响的综合研究，展现了他作为文化现象的复杂性和持久魅力。
objective.en: From historical and cultural perspectives, Li Bai has become an important symbol of Chinese culture, representing romantic spirit and a free-spirited approach to life. His poetry has been widely recited and has influenced countless later writers. In contemporary times, the image of Li Bai has been continuously reimagined in various literary, film, and artistic works, serving as an important cultural ambassador for China to the world. Academic research on Li Bai has evolved from purely literary appreciation to comprehensive studies of his thoughts, historical context, and cross-cultural influences, revealing the complexity and enduring appeal of him as a cultural phenomenon.

self.zh: 天生我材必有用，千金散尽还复来。
self.en: Heaven created me with a purpose, talents must be useful; a thousand gold pieces scattered will return again.

others.zh: 李白斗酒诗百篇，长安市上酒家眠。天子呼来不上船，自称臣是酒中仙。
others.en: Li Bai with a measure of wine composes a hundred poems; he sleeps drunk in taverns on the streets of Chang'an. When the emperor summons him, he won't board the boat, calling himself the immortal among wine drinkers.
